通俗来讲，就是解决“我在哪里、要去哪里、应该怎么走”。例如，机器人从房间一端出发.message: In everyday terms, it answers: where am I, where should I go, and how do I get there? A robot might cross a room, avoid obstacles on the floor, and reach a designated area at the doorway. Navigation chooses the route; locomotion executes the movement and turning commands.

导航涉及定位、建图、路径规划与避障。经典系统通常组合定位 / SLAM、全局规划.message: Navigation involves localization, mapping, path planning, and obstacle avoidance. Classical systems often combine localization / SLAM, a global planner such as A*, and local planning or control such as DWA or MPC. Mature engineering solutions exist for known maps and controlled environments.

导航常把移动能力作为执行基础：先决定目标或路径，再由运动控制把指令落到身体上。部.message: Navigation often relies on locomotion for execution: first choose a goal or path, then use motion control to carry it out. Some simulation benchmarks simplify low-level movement. Real deployment must also handle localization errors, slipping, dynamic obstacles, and execution failures. Compare task definitions, sensors, success conditions, and path efficiency together; a high success rate on one PointNav benchmark does not generalize to every navigation task.

用夹爪、灵巧手或吸盘等末端执行器，建立并维持对物体的稳定约束。典型的抓取检测（g.message: Use a gripper, dexterous hand, suction cup, or other end effector to establish and maintain stable constraints on an object. Typical grasp detection takes point clouds or RGB-D images and predicts a parallel gripper’s grasp pose: 3D position, 3D orientation (6-DoF), and gripper width. Execution also requires reachability and collision checks.

操作的范围包括抓取、搬运、推、拨、翻转、手内操作（in-hand manipul.message: Manipulation includes grasping, transporting, pushing, nudging, flipping, and in-hand manipulation, as well as folding clothes, arranging ropes, opening doors and drawers, using tools, bimanual coordination, and long-horizon tasks. Grasping is one subproblem; pushing an object or kicking a ball is non-prehensile manipulation that does not require grasping it first.

关注机器人自身的移动能力。足式机器人需要处理步态、平衡、台阶、斜坡和跌倒恢复；轮.message: Locomotion concerns the robot’s own mobility. Legged robots must handle gaits, balance, steps, slopes, and fall recovery. Wheeled robots also belong here, dealing with steering constraints, slipping, and uneven terrain. Whole-body control can connect mobility with manipulation.

让机器人从当前位置到达目标，涉及定位、建图、路径规划与避障。经典系统通常组合定位.message: Navigation moves a robot from its current location to a goal through localization, mapping, path planning, and obstacle avoidance. Classical systems often combine localization / SLAM, global planning such as A*, and local planning or control such as DWA or MPC. Mature engineering solutions exist for known maps and controlled environments.

把杯子拿稳是抓取；搬运、推移或倾倒杯子，都属于操作。.message: Holding a cup securely is grasping; carrying, pushing, or pouring from it are forms of manipulation.

导航决定去哪里、走哪条路；运动负责把这一步走出来。.message: Navigation chooses the destination and route; locomotion takes the next step.

可以借助“手和臂操作、腿或轮带动身体”建立直觉。分类依据是任务：脚也能踢球或推物.message: Thinking of hands and arms manipulating, and legs or wheels moving the body, can build intuition. The actual categories are task-based: a foot can kick or push an object, and a wheeled platform can carry an arm for manipulation.

机械臂用平行夹爪对准橙色方块，闭合夹爪，再将方块提离桌面。.message: An arm aligns its parallel gripper with an orange block, closes the fingers, and lifts the block off the table.

确定方块的位置与朝向，选择两侧的夹持区域。.message: Find the block’s position and orientation, then choose contact regions on opposite sides.

两侧指爪闭合，与物体接触并建立稳定夹持。.message: Close both fingers to make contact and establish a stable grasp.

保持夹持并向上提起；物体随夹爪移动，完成抓取。.message: Maintain the grasp and lift. The block moves with the gripper, completing the grasp.

机械臂夹住抽屉把手，持续保持接触，沿滑轨方向拉开抽屉。.message: The arm grasps the drawer handle, maintains contact, and pulls the drawer along its rails.

抓住只是开始。操作还要持续改变抽屉的状态。.message: Grasping is only the start. Manipulation continues to change the drawer’s state.

观察把手与滑轨方向，将夹爪移动到把手附近。.message: Observe the handle and rail direction, then move the gripper toward the handle.

夹住把手，为后续拉动建立稳定接触。.message: Grasp the handle to establish stable contact for pulling.

保持接触并沿滑轨移动；真实系统还需要根据视觉与力反馈修正动作。.message: Maintain contact while moving along the rails. A real system also corrects actions using visual and force feedback.

抽屉到达目标开度，机械臂停止拉动并保持位置。.message: When the drawer reaches the target opening, stop pulling and hold position.

看身体怎么移动：协调落脚位置、关节与重心。.message: Watch how the body moves by coordinating foot placement, joints, and center of mass.

四足落地支撑身体，准备向前移动。.message: All four feet support the body as the robot prepares to move forward.

支撑腿承重，摆动腿向前迈出，为下一步落脚做准备。.message: The support legs bear weight while the swing legs move forward to their next footholds.

提高摆腿轨迹，把脚落在台阶上，逐步抬高身体。.message: Raise the swing trajectory, place the feet on the steps, and gradually lift the body.

到达平台后收步，四足重新建立稳定支撑。.message: On reaching the platform, finish stepping and restore stable support on all four feet.

绕开障碍，到达目标.message: Avoid obstacles and reach the goal

轮式机器人从起点出发，沿规划路径绕过两个障碍物，到达终点后停下。.message: A wheeled robot follows a planned route around two obstacles and stops at the goal.

看目标与路线：决定去哪里、如何绕行、何时停止。.message: Watch the goal and route: where to go, how to avoid obstacles, and when to stop.

确定当前位置、目标位置，以及场地中障碍物的位置。.message: Identify the current position, goal, and obstacle locations.

规划绕开障碍的路线，同时为机器人身体留出通行空间。.message: Plan a route around the obstacles with enough clearance for the robot’s body.

根据路径输出移动与转向指令，由底盘控制执行。.message: Convert the path into movement and turning commands for the base controller.

进入目标区域后停止移动，并确认到达。.message: Stop inside the goal area and confirm arrival.
